description: evals/margin/scripts/run-smoke.sh stages the built wheel by globbing tether_it-*.whl (cp and basename) to bind-mount it into the eval container. That glob prefix is pyproject.toml [project].name normalized per PEP 427/503 (runs of - _ . collapse to _, so tether-it becomes tether_it). Renaming the distribution in pyproject.toml requires updating this glob, or it matches no wheel and the smoke run fails under set -e.
